name: tr_iggy
caption:
IF IGGY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🦵 Hitmonlee: an awesome sense of balance. #9 pick in 2004, then All-Rookie First Team
🌵 Ferrothorn: its steel spikes crush boulders. First year with us: All-Defensive First Team
🎭 Mimikyu: nobody knows what's under its disguise. 0 starts in 2014-15, off our bench all season
🛡️ Cobalion: its glare makes even unruly foes obey. First start of the season in the Finals, guarding LeBron. Finals MVP
🐢 Torterra: smaller monsters build their nests on its back. Back with us for ring number 4 in 2022
🦌 Xerneas: legends say it shares eternal life. His No. 9, retired by us in 2025

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Andre Iguodala had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF IGGY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Hitmonlee. It has an awesome sense of balance, and can kick from any position. Ninth pick, then All-Rookie First Team.
Ferrothorn. A hit from its steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble. His first year with us: All-Defensive First Team.
beats.dlg: ITS STEEL SPIKES CRUSH|BOULDERS. ALL-D 1ST TEAM!

beats.vo: Mimikyu. Nobody knows what's really under its disguise. In twenty fifteen he came off our bench all season. Zero starts.
beats.dlg: NOBODY KNOWS WHAT'S UNDER|ITS DISGUISE. 0 STARTS.

beats.vo: Cobalion. Its glare alone makes even an unruly foe obey. His first start came in the Finals, on LeBron James. Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: ITS GLARE MAKES FOES OBEY.|ON LEBRON: FINALS MVP!

beats.vo: Torterra. Small monsters gather on its back to build their nests. He came back to us for one more run. Ring number four, in twenty twenty-two.
beats.dlg: OTHERS BUILD ON ITS BACK.|RING NUMBER 4 IN 2022!

beats.vo: And the ace. Xerneas. Legends say it can share eternal life. We hung his number nine in the rafters forever.
beats.dlg: IT SHARES ETERNAL LIFE.|NO. 9, RETIRED FOREVER!

facts.claim: Iguodala: ninth (9) overall pick by the Philadelphia 76ers in 2004; NBA All-Rookie First Team (2005); acquired by Golden State in 2013; NBA All-Defensive First (1st) Team (2014), the 2013-14 season; in 2014-15 a reserve for the first time in his career; in the 2015 Finals he was the team's best defender against LeBron James and made his first start of the season in Game 4; 2015 Finals MVP; 4x NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022), with Golden State again 2021-2023; Golden State retired his No. 9 jersey on February 23, 2025
Hitmonlee: an awesome sense of balance; it can kick in succession from any position
Ferrothorn: a hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble
Mimikyu: its actual appearance is unknown; it conceals itself beneath an old rag
Cobalion: its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokemon obey it
Torterra: small Pokemon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests
Xerneas: legends say it can share eternal life
